kjv: Now shall I (Samson) be more blameless than the Philistines
mine: This time I (Samson) will be blameless toward the Philistines
note: Niqqeti min-pelishtim most naturally means 'I am clear (of guilt) with respect to the Philistines'; the min is not comparative here.

kjv: in the top of the rock Etam
mine: in the cleft of the rock of Etam
note: Seif means a cleft or fissure in rock (Isa 2:21, 57:5), a hiding place, not a summit; so also v. 11.

kjv: an hollow place that was in the jaw
mine: the hollow place that is at Lehi
note: Ballechi (with article) is the place Lehi named in vv. 9 and 14; the KJV takes it as the jawbone itself, so that water flows from the bone. Maktesh is a 'hollow, basin' in the terrain.
